description: Fetch the authenticated Codex model catalog and replace this provider's namespaced router slice; returns the active model count.

request_schema.description: Input of a provider's `provider::<id>::refresh_models` — takes no arguments. A struct (not `Value`) keeps the request schema concrete; unknown fields (e.g. the engine-injected `_caller_worker_id`) are ignored.
request_schema.title: RefreshModelsRequest
